tagline: AI/ML Engineer and Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION, building applied machine learning workflows and full-stack web software.
current_status: AI/ML Engineer | Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION
summary: Likith Naidu Anumakonda is an AI/ML Engineer and the Founder & CEO of SAKRA VISION, specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI.

He is currently pursuing a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) at Parvatha Reddy Babul Reddy Visvodaya Institute of Technology and Science (PBR VITS), Kavali, Andhra Pradesh, India, and completed an Advanced AI/ML Specialization programme at IIT Patna (I-HUB).
He is also a Classical Pianist and the Author of "Echoes of an Unsaid Goodbye".
technical_philosophy: Focusing on practical problem definition, structured APIs, clean data models, and reliable web and AI software delivery.
